seo.description: Answers to the most common questions about booking, sessions, privacy, and payment.

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.description: Answers to the most common questions before starting your journey with us.

privacy.question: Are sessions confidential?
privacy.answer: Yes, we maintain complete privacy and confidentiality for all your information.

booking.question: How can I book a session?
booking.answer: You can book through the booking form or contact us directly.

online.question: Do you offer online sessions?
online.answer: Yes, online sessions are available depending on specialist availability.

duration.question: How long does a session take?
duration.answer: Session duration depends on the service type and individual needs.

payment.question: What payment methods are available?
payment.answer: You can pay online via credit card or digital wallet, or in cash at the clinic.

cancel.question: Can I cancel or reschedule a session?
cancel.answer: Yes, you can cancel or reschedule up to 24 hours before your session with no extra charge.

cta.title: Still Have Questions?
cta.description: Reach out to us directly and we'll be happy to help answer anything on your mind.
